title: Compliance Bulletin: Insurance Claim Services Billing Arrangements, Instruments and the Florida Assignment Cutoff
content:
**Rule.** The customer's customer type must be one of the customer types in the entry gate of the arrangement being opened. A Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing file requires a public adjuster name on file, and a Carrier Program Claim Billing file requires a carrier referral number on file. An Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing file may not be opened when the policy state is FL and the policy issue date is on or after the Florida assignment cutoff date. Florida law makes post-loss assignments of benefits invalid under residential and commercial property policies issued on or after January 1, 2023, so such a file is opened as Direction to Pay Claim Billing instead when the insured agrees to sign a direction to pay. The arrangements are mutually exclusive: the company does not take an assignment of benefits from an insured who is represented by a public adjuster, and a carrier program referral is billed only under Carrier Program Claim Billing. The direction to pay or assignment is signed by the insured; the company never signs it on the insured's behalf.

The Florida assignment cutoff date is 2023-01-01. These conditions govern the opening of every Insurance Claim Services claim file; whether a public adjuster, a referral number or an assignment instrument belongs to an arrangement is part of each tier's own figures.

## Which evidence decides each condition

| Condition | What decides it |
|---|---|
| Customer type within the arrangement's entry gate | the customer type on the customer's record (a system record), checked before the file is opened |
| Public adjuster name on file (Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing) | the public adjuster name given for the claim, as stated by the caller, tied to the carrier claim number |
| Carrier referral number on file (Carrier Program Claim Billing) | the referral number given for the claim, as stated by the caller, tied to the carrier claim number |
| Florida assignment restriction (Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing) | the policy state and policy issue date stated by the caller for that carrier claim number |

## The Florida restriction, both sides

| Policy state | Policy issue date | Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing may be opened? |
|---|---|---|
| FL | 2023-01-01 | no — on the cutoff date |
| FL | 2022-12-31 | yes — before the cutoff date |
| a state other than FL | any | yes |

Where the assignment may not be opened, the file is opened as Direction to Pay Claim Billing instead when the insured agrees to sign a direction to pay.

## Points of judgement

- An insured represented by a public adjuster does not sign an assignment of benefits with the company.
- A carrier program referral is billed only under Carrier Program Claim Billing.
- The insured signs the direction to pay or the assignment personally; the company never signs it for the insured.
